exposure: Alternating doses of pentazocine and acetaminophen group
Alternating doses of intramuscular pentazocine and acetaminophen
outcome: Time taken for the return of bowel sounds
cohort: 142 women undergoing elective caesarean section at Ahmadu Bello University Teaching Hospital, Zaria, Nigeria
finding: Both intramuscular pentazocine alone and alternating doses of intramuscular pentazocine and acetaminophen provided comparable analgesic efficacy, incidence of side effects, and satisfaction levels for post-caesarean section pain management.
